providers.title: Principalization
providers.scope: Triples (X, I, E) with X smooth of finite type over a field of characteristic zero, I an ideal sheaf nonzero on every component and E an snc divisor; compatible with smooth morphisms. The isomorphism locus is the complement of the cosupport of I together with the singular locus of E.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Elimination of indeterminacy
providers.scope: X smooth, U dense open in X, Y proper over the base field, f: U -> Y a morphism; the composite of blow-ups is an isomorphism over U.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Resolution of singularities
providers.scope: Reduced schemes of finite type over a field of characteristic zero; proper, an isomorphism over the smooth locus, snc exceptional divisor, compatible with smooth morphisms; projective for quasi-projective schemes.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Proper smooth models
providers.scope: Reduced schemes of finite type in characteristic zero; a proper morphism from a smooth scheme that is an isomorphism over a dense open subset.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Smooth compactification
providers.scope: Smooth separated schemes of finite type in characteristic zero; an open dense immersion into a smooth proper scheme whose boundary is the support of an snc divisor; projective for quasi-projective input.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
